name: axiomaticai
description: Hand engineering and science work to Lemma: start a conversation, send files, wait for the run, read the answer, download results, and open it in the browser.

open_browser.title: Open conversations in the browser
open_browser.description: Open each new conversation in your browser as soon as a message is sent.

default_model.title: Default model
default_model.description: The model a new conversation starts on when Claude names none, as the model picker shows it: Anthropic · Pro Fast, Anthropic · Pro, Anthropic · Normal, Google · Pro, Google · Normal, Open-weight · Pro or Open-weight · Normal. Left empty, Lemma uses the model it would in the browser.
